description: LOXPEX crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C72 H60 Dy4 N32 O20,8(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.646-3.646 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 97.03-101.60°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy4(HL-pyra)2(L-pyra)4(NO3)2(H2O)2]·8H2O (C72H78Dy4N32O28).
